tables.notes: Publication date: 7 November 1949. Historical labels are retained; Algiers, Libya and Tripolitania are not silently remapped or combined. Hyphenated shorthand such as 280-300,000 is retained, and no midpoint is substituted. Blank cells mean no qualification was printed. Regional subtotals are not extra populations.

tables.title: Membership of Jewish Community at Berlin
tables.notes: These are community membership counts, not a count of every Jewish resident of Berlin. The grand-total column places 736 alongside the end of the under-19 group and 6099 alongside the end of the adult group. Blank cells are preserved and are not converted to zero. Overlapping age boundaries, as printed, are not silently repaired. Marginal handwritten calculations and percentages are excluded from the typed table.

tables.notes: First panel on PDF p. 4. Printed dashes remain dashes; blank row totals remain blank. Handwritten added row totals are not included in the typed table. Printed panel total: 405.

tables.title: Population statistics: Thuringen, Dresden, Brandenburg and Leipzig

jdc-population-report-68-1949.scope: Four statistical tables from PDF pp. 2–4; the cover on p. 1 is retained as a scan. Marginal handwriting is not a full transcription. No country or age-group row is entered as a person, organization, donor or gift.

statistics-jews-united-states-1880.image_credit: Page images: HathiTrust, hvd.hnrqec (Harvard University copy, digitized by Google), https://hdl.handle.net/2027/hvd.hnrqec. Images are not copied into this site.
statistics-jews-united-states-1880.scope: All state tables (printed pp. 6–54), the printed national totals (p. 55) and Appendices A–D (pp. 56–59) transcribed from a scan read page by page: 1288 place and organization rows. The errata Note on p. 59 is applied (Zanesville 100, Indianapolis 400, Wabash 125). Places and population figures are not indexed as people. Named congregations and societies are also indexed as a directory list.
